observations.why: The gate is framed as a security-and-stability safeguard — a conservation appeal to keeping deployments controlled and safe.

observations.why: Citing past failures as the justification for the gate appeals to security and stability (conservation) while the corrective gate itself signals a quality-of-craft motive (competence).
